-- Parse "HH:MM" to minutes from midnight
local function toMins(t)
  local h,m = t:match("^(%d+):(%d+)$")
  return tonumber(h)*60 + tonumber(m)
end

-- Check if a [start, end) interval (in minutes) is free for all users on a given day
local function allFree(day, slotStart, slotEnd)
  for _, u in ipairs(users) do
    for _, b in ipairs(avail[u][day]) do
      local bs = toMins(b.s)
      local be = toMins(b.e)
      -- Overlap if slotStart < be and slotEnd > bs
      if slotStart < be and slotEnd > bs then
        return false
      end
    end
  end
  return true
end

local workStart = 9*60  -- 09:00

for _, day in ipairs(days) do
  -- Try every 30-min boundary start
  local t = workStart
  while t + 60 <= workEnd do
    if allFree(day, t, t+60) then
      local sh = math.floor(t/60)
      local sm = t % 60
      local eh = math.floor((t+60)/60)
      local em = (t+60) % 60
      return {
        day = day,
        start = string.format("%sT%02d:%02d:00Z", day, sh, sm),
        end_time = string.format("%sT%02d:%02d:00Z", day, eh, em)
      }
    end
    t = t + 30
  end
end
